解析：$\frac{\partial P}{\partial x}=xz^2,\frac{\partial Q}{\partial y}=x^2,\frac{\partial R}{\partial z}=y^2,$

$$=\iiint_{\Omega}(z^2+x^2+y^2)dv$$

原式

$$=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin\varphi d\varphi\int_0^a r^4dr=\frac{2}{5}\pi a^5.$$
